[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] '''Khoveri''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Consular]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] active during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They sold [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], including articles resembling his own [[Jedi apparel/Legends|attire]], and other items to fellow Consulars near the entrance to the [[Senate Commercial District]] in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Among the items Khoveri sold were [[Hat/Legends|headgear]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]], [[Robe/Legends|robes]], [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TOR" />

Khoveri had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The Nautolan wore a white robe with a gold pattern, white boots, and a dark grey [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with gold circles on it. Their head tendrils had brown bands on them, and a lightsaber hung from the belt. Khoveri greeted their customers in a [[Language/Legends|language]] other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khoveri appeared as the Legacy vendor for the Jedi Consular class<ref name="TOR" /> in the [[2012]] Game Update 1.2 for<ref name="Update 1.2 Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20120329|text=Your Legacy Begins}}</ref> the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
